_comment: Documentation word budgets, enforced by tests/docs/test_doc_budgets.py from the pages.yml workflow. Metric: one word per CJK character plus one word per maximal latin/digit run, counted after stripping fenced code blocks and HTML comments. Calibration: README.md and docs/future-roadmap.md are current size +20%, every pages/*.md is current size +50%, all rounded to the nearest hundred. Keys starting with '_' document the manifest and are not budgets.
_agents_note: AGENTS.md is pinned to its present 5075 words rounded to 5100, not to the agreed 1950-word target: that target only becomes reachable once the .agents/notes/ migration moves the P0 contract detail out of the file. Ratchet this entry down in that change.
